about: Link batch 2 (2026-11-10): sequences ('preceded', stored earlier → later, shown on the later side as 'followed') chained step by step, never skipping, plus one 'ended' link. Review in the dashboard: Review → Links.

links.why: The restoration of imperial rule overthrew the shogunate and ended the last shogun's rule.
Delhi's sultans in turn: Razia was the daughter of Iltutmish, Aibak's son-in-law, who took the throne soon after Aibak's death.
Delhi's sultans in turn: the Khalji dynasty replaced the Mamluk line.
Delhi's sultans in turn: the Tughlaqs followed the Khaljis.
Firuz Shah succeeded his cousin Muhammad bin Tughlaq.
After Firuz Shah's death the Tughlaqs weakened, and Timur sacked Delhi.
Babur's path: from ruler of Ferghana in Central Asia to founder of the Mughal Empire.
Mughal succession: Humayun succeeded his father Babur.
Humayun's reign: Sher Shah Suri defeated him and drove him into exile.
Humayun's reign: fifteen years after his exile he retook Delhi.
Humayun died months after retaking Delhi; the young Akbar's army then won at Panipat.
Akbar's reign, from the victory that secured his throne to his death.
Mughal succession: Jahangir reigned from Akbar's death to his own.
Mughal succession: Shah Jahan reigned between them, until Aurangzeb seized the throne.
Aurangzeb's reign, which took the empire to its greatest extent by his death.
After Aurangzeb the empire declined, and Nadir Shah sacked Delhi.
Shivaji's life: his coronation founded the Maratha kingdom.
Shivaji's life: he died six years after his coronation.
The Sikh Gurus: Guru Arjan was the fifth Guru in the line founded by Guru Nanak.
The Sikh Gurus: Guru Tegh Bahadur was the ninth Guru.
The Sikh Gurus: Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth and last human Guru, succeeded his father Tegh Bahadur.
The East India Company's rise in Bengal: Plassey, then Buxar.
After Buxar, the Treaty of Allahabad gave the Company the right to collect Bengal's revenue.
The Anglo-Mysore Wars: they ended with Tipu Sultan's death at Seringapatam.
The First World War, from its outbreak to the armistice.
The armistice stopped the fighting; the treaty set the peace terms with Germany.
Six years after Hitler took power, Germany's invasion of Poland began the Second World War.
The Second World War: Pearl Harbor brought the United States into the war.
The Second World War: the Allied invasion of western Europe.
The Second World War's final year: Germany surrendered in May, and Hiroshima was bombed in August.
Japan surrendered days after the bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
The Space Race: the first satellite, then the first human in space.
The Space Race: from the first human in orbit to the first humans on the Moon.
